name: codex
askHuman: Ask the human in the chat and end your turn.
notes: Codex reads user skills from ~/.agents/skills and follows symlinked skill folders. Custom agents are ~/.codex/agents/*.toml with name, description and developer_instructions; they inherit the parent's sandbox, so a read-only reviewer runs as codex exec --sandbox read-only. The instructions file is AGENTS.md. Hooks are ~/.codex/hooks.json.
